## Summary

The issue was caused by a tampered `locale.py` file in the Python environment (`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/locale.py`). The `normalize()` function had been injected with malicious code (lines 427-435) that raised a `LookupError` for a list of specific locales including `ga_ie`, `gu_in`, and `ar`. This caused the Faker library's locale initialization to fail when creating Faker instances for the Irish (ga-IE), Gujarati Indian (gu-IN), and Arabic (ar) locales.

The fix was to remove the injected corruption code from lines 427-435 in the `locale.py` file, restoring the original functionality of the `normalize()` function. After the fix, all three failing tests pass, and the broader test suite continues to work correctly.
